Scope: Catalog-driven package prerequisite expansion, removal ordering, mutation guard, offline bundle coverage, package lifecycle and evidence regressions
Implementation: Expands declared package prerequisites before consumers and reports the reason.
Deduplicates compatible selections and rejects conflicting or unsatisfied prerequisites.
Removes selected dependents before prerequisites and refuses to remove a prerequisite while an installed dependent remains.
Revalidates package dependency closure at the mutation boundary and rejects hand-built incomplete plans before state capture or handler dispatch.
Allows pending unsupported prerequisites only when their installed state already satisfies the declared dependency.
Offline profile coverage includes catalog prerequisites and offline dispatch accepts them only when ordered before consumers.
EnvironmentLimit: The initial direct Invoke-Pester attempt enabled Pester's TestRegistry plugin and was denied HKCU access before tests ran. The successful rerun disabled that plugin. Application package portable lifecycle fixtures use unique .local paths because sandbox AppContainer temporary paths deny atomic manifest moves.
EstimateImpact: No legacy outcome closed, retired or excluded. Estimates remain settings 38-58, packages 52-67, components 19-24, files/assets 25-35, maintenance 8-12; exact 142-196, rounded 145-200/about 170. Dependency-plan expansion and v14 runtime acceptance remain open.
